var rgbPrimaries = vImageRGBPrimaries(
    red_x: 0.64,
    green_x: 0.3,
    blue_x: 0.15,
    white_x: 0.3127,
    
    red_y: 0.33,
    green_y: 0.6,
    blue_y: 0.06,
    white_y: 0.329)
        
var transferFunction = vImageTransferFunction(
    c0: 1.099,
    c1: 1.0,
    c2: 0.0,
    c3: -0.099,
    gamma: 0.45,
    cutoff: 0.018,
    c4: 4.5,
    c5: 0)
        
let colorSpace = vImageCreateRGBColorSpaceWithPrimariesAndTransferFunction(
    &rgbPrimaries,
    &transferFunction,
    .defaultIntent,
    vImage_Flags(kvImageNoFlags),
    nil)
```
